name: Weather Oracle
description: Real-time weather data oracle. Returns temperature, humidity, and conditions for any location. Updated every 5 minutes from multiple data sources.

name: Crypto Price Feed
description: Aggregated cryptocurrency price feed. Supports BTC, ETH, XLM, and 50+ tokens. Returns price, 24h change, and volume. Data from 5 major exchanges.

name: AI Inference Endpoint
description: On-chain AI inference service. Submit prompts for GPT-class text generation. Supports up to 4096 tokens. Response includes inference hash for verification.

name: Demo Payee Vendor (x402)
description: x402-style SEP-41 payment to a demo vendor. Uses transfer(from, pay_to, amount) on the token contract. Budget is scoped per (asset, pay_to) pair independently of other payees.
